hero.headline: Stocks have their best day since April 2025, but a December Fed hike looks near certain.
hero.dek: Every story on FIOPO is traced to where it lands: your fuel, your rent, your savings, your job. Here is how today's biggest story travels.

chain.label: The event
chain.text: The S&P 500 rose 4.7% to 7,237.17 on Monday, its best day since April 2025, and won back just over half of last week's loss. The Nasdaq jumped 6.5% and the Dow gained 1,447.98 points, AP reports.

chain.label: The trigger
chain.text: Nvidia surged 31.5% after its board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, a week after the stock fell nearly 23%. The VIX fear gauge dropped about 26% to 26.62.

chain.label: The world
chain.text: On Tuesday South Korea's KOSPI rose 6.5% to 5,014.41, Japan's Nikkei 3.9% and Taiwan's Taiex more than 9%. TSMC added $158 billion in market value in one day, Fortune reports.

chain.label: The catch
chain.text: New York Fed President John Williams said inflation is still too high. Traders now see about a 95% chance of a quarter point rate hike at the Fed's December 8 to 9 meeting, Yahoo Finance reports.

chain.label: You
chain.text: The 10 year Treasury yield sat near 4.93%, which keeps mortgage and loan rates high. Wednesday's PCE inflation report, forecast at 3.8% a year, is the next test.

hero.caption: Sources: AP, Fortune, Reuters, Yahoo Finance and TraderFactor, November 23 to 24, 2026. The chain itself is FIOPO analysis.

stories.headline: Stocks have their best day since April 2025 as Nvidia jumps 31.5%.
stories.happened: On Monday the S&P 500 rose 326.78 points, or 4.7%, to 7,237.17, ending a seven day losing streak. The Dow rose 1,447.98 points, or 3%, to 49,595.31, the Nasdaq 6.5% to 24,089.56 and the Russell 2000 3.4% to 2,669.66, AP reports. Nvidia rose 31.5% after its board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. The VIX fell to 26.62.
stories.happening: Early Tuesday, Dow futures were up 0.1%, S&P 500 futures were near flat and Nasdaq 100 futures were down 0.3%, while Nvidia slipped 3% before the open, Yahoo Finance reported. Asia rallied: the KOSPI rose 6.5%, the Nikkei 3.9% and Taiwan more than 9%, while the Hang Seng lagged. Dell, HP, Best Buy, Medtronic, Analog Devices, Workday and Dollar Tree report earnings on Tuesday, and the Conference Board consumer confidence index is expected at 92.1, from 91.7. US markets close Thursday for Thanksgiving.

could.text: A one day rally after a seven day slide does not settle the market's direction. Wednesday's PCE inflation report and the Fed's December decision matter more now.

you: Saving for retirement? Keep your regular contributions on schedule; trying to time a 4.7% day is how investors miss them.
Rebalance only if your stock share has drifted well past your target, and do it on a set date, not after a headline.
Need the money within two years? Keep it in savings or short Treasury bills, not in stocks.
stories.watch: Consumer confidence at 10 a.m. ET Tuesday, then PCE inflation at 8:30 a.m. ET Wednesday.

stories.headline: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz as Qatar works to revive talks.
stories.happened: Iran's Revolutionary Guard navy said on Monday that three tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, despite a US Navy escort, Iranian state media reported. It said US escorts would not exempt shipowners from its traffic rules. US Central Command had not responded, and the claim could not be independently verified.
stories.happening: Qatar's prime minister is working with Iran and the US to revive negotiations and met Vice President Vance and Secretary of State Rubio, Newsquawk reports. Iran wants sanctions lifted, frozen assets released and the US naval blockade removed; the US wants nuclear concessions. Brent fell 3.45% on Monday to $89.39, a three month low, and traded near $89 on Tuesday. Goldman Sachs raised its December Brent forecast to $105 from $90. The Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Arabia's Rabigh refinery; Saudi officials have not confirmed damage.

could.note: FIOPO read for the next 30 days, unchanged from November 17. Brent at $89.39 is still inside the range despite the mine claims. Judgment, not fact.

you: Driving for Thanksgiving? The US average is $3.61 a gallon; fill up before Wednesday's rush.
Flying through the Gulf? Check your airline's change rules and your government's travel advice before you go.
Heat with oil or propane? Ask your dealer about a fixed price plan for the winter.

stories.headline: The Fed's Williams says inflation is still too high as traders bet on a December hike.
stories.happened: New York Fed President John Williams said on Monday that inflation is too high and the Fed must act over time to bring it back to 2%. He expects inflation to end 2026 at 3.5% and reach the target in 2028, and said he would not rule out moves at consecutive meetings. The Fed's rate range is 3.75% to 4.00%, Reuters reports.
stories.happening: Traders see about a 95% chance of a quarter point hike at the December meeting and a 5% chance of a half point, Yahoo Finance reported Tuesday. Governor Christopher Waller has signaled he could support a half point move, Reuters says. The 2 year Treasury yield rose to 4.683% and the dollar index hit a fresh annual high of 104.33 on Monday, IC Markets says. November's flash composite PMI fell to 54.6 from 55.9. Wednesday's PCE report is forecast to show inflation at 3.8% a year, up from 3.6%.

could.text: A hotter PCE reading on Wednesday would raise talk of a bigger move.
could.note: Market odds from futures pricing, Yahoo Finance, November 24. Not a FIOPO call.

you: Carrying a credit card balance? Rates follow the Fed; pay down the highest rate card first.
Shopping for a mortgage? Ask your lender about a rate lock before the December 9 decision.
Holding cash? Compare high yield savings and money market rates, which tend to rise after hikes.
stories.watch: PCE inflation at 8:30 a.m. ET Wednesday.

stories.headline: The US blacklists an Alibaba unit and six other firms linked to Megaspeed.
stories.happened: The Commerce Department added seven companies in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand to its Entity List on Monday, including Megaspeed International and Apex Enterprise Solutions, Alibaba's Singapore subsidiary. It cited the risk of moving advanced AI chips to buyers the US has not approved. Export licenses for them will face a presumption of denial.
stories.happening: Alibaba said the listing is erroneous because Apex never diverted restricted chips, and that it will seek all legal avenues. Its Hong Kong shares were down 0.5% on Tuesday afternoon. Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said Singapore does not want to be used as a conduit to evade US controls and its investigation continues. Senators Maria Cantwell and Pete Ricketts said Commerce still owes Congress answers. The rule is due in the Federal Register on Wednesday.

could.text: Alibaba's legal challenge and congressional probes could keep export controls in the headlines for weeks.

you: Own Alibaba or a China tech fund? Expect headline swings; check how much of your fund sits in Chinese tech.
Buy cloud computing in Southeast Asia? Ask providers how US export rules affect their chip supply.
Work in tech trade or compliance? Entity List changes are a sign to review your customer screening.

regions.covers: China, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Southeast Asia
regions.headline: Korea and Taiwan chip stocks surge while Hong Kong lags.
regions.text: On Tuesday Seoul's KOSPI rose 6.5% to 5,014.41, with Samsung up 7.5% and SK Hynix 8.6%, AP reports. TSMC rose 9.9%, the daily limit, adding about $158 billion in value. The Hang Seng and Shanghai traded mixed. China's central bank set the yuan midpoint at 6.7111 per dollar. Fortune reports China and Japan relations remain frozen after Xi Jinping and Sanae Takaichi only shook hands at APEC in Shenzhen.
regions.you: Own an Asia fund? Single day moves near 10% cut both ways; check how much of it sits in two or three chip stocks.

sources.name: AP via KSAT, Asian markets, Nov 24

regions.covers: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka
regions.headline: Indian stocks slip ahead of monthly expiry as Hasina plans a return.
regions.text: The Sensex fell 331.21 points to 84,900.71 and the Nifty 108.65 points to 25,959.50 on November 24, with IT the only gaining sector, Moneycontrol reports. HAL fell 3% after a Tejas fighter jet crashed at a Dubai airshow. Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina plans to return to Bangladesh on December 16, Reuters reports.
regions.you: Investing in Indian funds? Expiry days bring extra swings, so avoid large trades right around them.

regions.headline: European fertilizer plants shut as stocks gave back early gains.
regions.text: European fertilizer producers have shut plants, with a third of ammonia output suspended, the Financial Times reports via Newsquawk. The Euro Stoxx 50 closed up 2.2% on Monday, but futures pointed lower on Tuesday. Russia's defense ministry said it hit a vessel southwest of Odesa and a power substation in Chernihiv region. About 60 Patriot interceptors for Ukraine await Pentagon approval, the FT reports.
regions.you: Farm or garden at scale? Fertilizer prices often rise when European ammonia output falls, so price your spring orders early.

regions.headline: Qatar's prime minister meets Vance and Rubio to restart Iran talks.
regions.text: Qatar's Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani is working with Iran and the US to revive negotiations, Newsquawk reports. Iran's air defense said it destroyed a US drone, and the Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed a Houthi drone. Kpler said Iran appears to be testing the US naval blockade with spoofed tracking signals, with no confirmed breach.
regions.you: Shipping goods through the Gulf? Ask your freight forwarder about war risk surcharges before you book.

regions.covers: Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Egypt, Sahel
regions.headline: Nigeria's central bank decides on rates today with the naira near 1,394.
regions.text: Nigeria's Monetary Policy Committee ends its last meeting of 2026 on Tuesday, with the policy rate at 23% after a 350 basis point cut in September. Inflation eased to 14.06% in October from 14.63% in September, but food inflation is 19.13%. The naira closed Monday at 1,394.01 per dollar on the official market, its weakest close in about eight months, and reserves were $54.58 billion.
regions.you: Sending money to Nigeria? Compare official and transfer app rates; the gap to the street rate was about 51 naira on Monday.

regions.headline: Brazil's lower house passes spending curbs as stocks hit a six month low.
regions.text: Brazil's Chamber of Deputies approved the main text of a fiscal bill by 353 votes to 128 on Monday night. It would cap real spending growth at 2% instead of 2.5% in some years, and the government estimates a 2027 gain of R$45.1 billion to R$56.1 billion. The Ibovespa fell 0.95% to 164,796, 21.2% below its October 9 peak, and the dollar closed at 5.9306 reais. Petrobras raised its five year investment plan to $122 billion.
regions.you: Visiting Brazil? The real is near its weakest in over a year, so your dollars go further; pay in reais at card terminals.

sports.headline: Manchester United's revenue rises 4.1% but its quarterly loss grows.
sports.text: In the quarter to September 30, revenue rose to £146.1 million from £140.3 million, while the wage bill rose 8.6% to £79.9 million. The after tax loss was £18.1 million, up 174.2%. Long term debt rose to £577.4 million after a refinancing, while interest payments fell 32% to £14.5 million.
sports.you: Own shares in a listed club? Watch wages against revenue; when wages grow faster, profits usually shrink.

sports.headline: The NBA says viewership is up 37% in the first month of its new TV deals.
sports.text: The NBA reported a 37% viewership increase through the first month of the season, with NBC averaging 4.5 million viewers, Front Office Sports reported on November 23. The 37% figure is the league's own claim.
sports.you: Paying for several streaming services to follow one league? Check which games sit on free broadcast TV before you renew.

sports.headline: Super Bowl LXI will play in IMAX theaters as Disney widens distribution.
sports.text: Disney will show Super Bowl LXI in hundreds of IMAX theaters, Front Office Sports reported on November 23, part of a wider push to put the game on more screens.
sports.you: Planning a Super Bowl outing? Theater seats for big live events often sell out early, so watch for ticket releases.

entertainment.headline: Ramayana passes Rs 1,580 crore worldwide in 16 days.
entertainment.text: The Indian epic reached Rs 1,582.95 crore worldwide gross after 16 days, including Rs 879.50 crore net in India and an estimated Rs 532 crore overseas, Sacnilk reports. It took $2.1 million in the US over the November 20 to 22 weekend.
entertainment.you: Indian films now get wide overseas releases. Check local theater listings rather than waiting for streaming.

entertainment.headline: Four new films arrive for Thanksgiving after the Hunger Games' $120 million opening.
entertainment.text: Sunrise on the Reaping opened to about $120 million in North America and $225 million worldwide on a reported budget of about $150 million. Thanksgiving week brings Focker in Law, Disney's animated Hexed, Netflix's The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth in IMAX, and Neon's Paper Tiger.
entertainment.you: Going to the movies over the holiday? Matinees and theater loyalty programs are the easiest way to cut ticket costs.

innovation.headline: IBM says its quantum computer solved a problem classical computers can't in 15 minutes.
innovation.text: IBM and the University of Chicago reported a quantum computer result that solved, in about 15 minutes, a problem beyond reach of classical computers, ScienceDaily reported on November 23.
innovation.you: Work in finance, chemistry or logistics? These are the fields expected to use quantum computing first, so it is worth tracking.

innovation.headline: Scientists find how microbes make drug-like molecules.
innovation.text: University of Michigan researchers reported in Science on November 23 that a protein family called REACT lets bacteria and fungi build complex drug-like molecules, with more than 40,000 related proteins identified.
innovation.you: Follow biotech? Discoveries like this can shorten the search for new antibiotics, though new drugs take years to reach pharmacies.

innovation.headline: Experts warn the US is building just 10% of the power lines it needs.
innovation.text: A report covered by ScienceDaily on November 23 says the United States is building only about a tenth of the high voltage transmission lines it needs to meet rising power demand.
innovation.you: Seeing higher electricity bills? Ask your utility about time of use plans; grid limits tend to raise peak hour prices first.

travel.headline: Lake Balaton, Hungary: a lake holiday without Como's crowds.
travel.text: Lonely Planet named Lake Balaton one of its most underrated places for 2027, for summer festivals, castles and lavender fields, as an alternative to Lake Como.
travel.you: Planning summer 2027? Look at lakeside towns now, and pay in forint rather than accepting a card conversion to dollars.

travel.headline: St. Augustine, Florida: Spanish streets without a transatlantic flight.
travel.text: Lonely Planet's 2027 underrated list includes St. Augustine for centuries of history and Spanish style streets that give a European feel on a domestic trip.
travel.you: Want old Europe on a short break? A domestic trip skips passports and long haul fares. Check the official visitor site for events before you book.

travel.headline: The dollar buys more in Argentina and Brazil than in a year.
travel.text: Argentina's peso closed at 1,580 per dollar on November 20, its weakest in at least 12 months, and Brazil's real closed near 5.93, its weakest since January 2025. Lonely Planet's 2027 list also picks Bolivia and Quito.
travel.you: Pay in the local currency when a card terminal offers dollars, and use a card with no foreign transaction fee.

picks.title: What Should My Children Do?
picks.text: An economist asks what the next generation should learn, and what it should stop worrying about, in a world changed by AI. Useful for any family planning school or career choices.

picks.title: Primetime Preacher$
picks.text: A 113 minute film on Jim Bakker, Jerry Falwell and Jimmy Swaggart, three 1980s televangelists who built TV ministries before scandal. A sharp look at how money flows when trust is the product.

items.text: NASA ran a developmental RS-25 Moon rocket engine for its full 200 seconds at Stennis Space Center.
Scientists found bacteria that removed about 98% of radioactive promethium-147 in 60 hours.
India declared at 720 for 9 in Wellington, the highest Test innings ever made in New Zealand.
NASA's Voyager 1 reached one light-day from Earth.
BepiColombo is entering orbit around Mercury, only the second spacecraft ever to do so.
ESA's Hera is arriving at the asteroid Didymos to study the crater from NASA's DART impact.
Artemis II splashed down off San Diego after a 10 day trip around the Moon, the first crewed lunar voyage in more than 50 years.
NASA's Perseverance set the record for distance driven on another world, more than 45 km on Mars.
The Hubble Space Telescope completed its 200,000th orbit of Earth.
